title: Stock count progress with COUNT
objective: Use COUNT to count the cells that hold numbers, and use the result in a calculation.
instructions: A stock count is in progress. Column A numbers the 10 lines in the list. Column C holds the pairs counted so far: some lines hold text such as n/a or TBC, and some are still empty. Fill F2:F5. F2: how many lines are in the list (count the numbers in A2:A11). F3: how many lines have a number in C2:C11. F4: how many lines are still to be counted (list less counted). F5: the average pairs per counted line, worked out as the total pairs divided by the number of counted lines.
hints: COUNT counts only the cells that contain numbers. Text and empty cells are ignored: =COUNT(C2:C11).
F4 is a subtraction using the two cells above it: =F2-F3.
For F5, divide a total by a count: =SUM(C2:C11)/F3. A zero counts as a counted line because 0 is a number.
